summary: BrenX Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on the US market, filed a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $2,886,058 of ordinary shares under its existing Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, dated June 9, 2023 and amended June 3, 2026. The filing includes an Israeli legal opinion on issuance legality and is incorporated by reference into numerous Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; no board recommendation, structural notes, or regulatory clock apply.
